name: tests-75pct-goss-resource-dependency-aware-validation
instr:
Support File and Command prerequisites in YAML and JSON using `dependencies: [{resource: {type: file, id: source}, policy: 0}]`. Resolve dependency-free configurations, typed File/Command maps, dependency-free Gossfile markers, and later duplicate replacements after merging. Keep registry entries for file, command, dns, http, addr, group, interface, and gossfile usable.

Reject missing references with errors naming the consumer and missing resource. Reject self-dependencies and cycles with errors naming every participant. Gossfile markers accept dependencies and participate in cycles like other resources.

Expose terminal results and states through ValidationReport. A failed File prerequisite is DependencyFailed; its strict Command dependent is DependencyBlocked and has one result whose Dependency() identifies the blocked state and prerequisite. Disabled File prerequisites are DependencySkipped and block strict dependents. WithDependencyPolicy(DependencyRequireCompletion) allows a File dependent of a failed File to succeed. An already-cancelled context gives the File resource DependencyCancelled. ValidateConfig returns a nonzero status without a call error for dependency failures; cancelled report validation returns DependencyCancelled without a call error.

Dependency-free Validate succeeds consistently with a DependencySatisfied report. A ValidationPlan containing one File emits one result group. Configuration retains the requested MaxConcurrent value.
